thread:
Marisol D: FYI saw a reconciliation alert this morning  dozens of Stripe usage invoices from 2026-03-10 didn't map to NetSuite. Recon flagged 29 items as 'NO_MAPPING'. Anyone on usage pipelines?

Billing Bot: Automated alert: 2026-03-11T07:03:12Z 1 29 webhook failures to /integrations/netsuite with 422: missing external_id. Recent deploy?

Nate R: we deployed billing-processor @2026-03-10 22:40 (PR #5238) which updated ingestion for usage invoices to batch them. I wonder if the batcher strips per-invoice metadata when constructing the batch payload.

Priya V: good catch. The batcher builds payloads like `{"batch_id":"b_20260310_1","invoices":[{id,amount},{id,amount}]}` and we changed it to drop `metadata` to reduce payload size. That was intentional but evidently netsuite expects `external_id` under invoice.metadata.

Marisol D: oh no. So these invoices hit the import without external ids. Can we re-run mapping for the 29 invoices and re-import? Also need to patch batcher.

Nate R: quick plan: 1) patch batcher to include metadata.external_id when present (small revert), 2) run a targeted backfill to attach external_id for the 29 invoices from customer mapping table, 3) re-send netsuite import for those invoices with idempotency keys.

Priya V: I'll open PR #5245 with the batcher fix and add a unit test to ensure metadata is preserved. Also will add an opt-in flag `BATCH_STRIP_METADATA=false` for rollout safety.

Accounting Bot: Job scheduled: backfill-external-ids for 29 invoices. ETA start 30m.

Marisol D: do we have any customers impacted for billing statements? Any churn risk?

Nate R: most are internal test accounts or small customers; I scanned top revenue accounts and none affected. Still want to fix quickly.

Priya V: PR opened and deploying to staging now. Backfill dry-run shows 27/29 mapped, 2 need manual resolution (missing mapping in customers table).

Marisol D: good. Please post back when backfill completes; I'll re-run recon then.

Accounting Bot: backfill run complete: 27 linked, 2 flagged. Netsuite import requeued for 27 invoices with idempotency keys. Import responses: 200 OK x27.

Marisol D: recon shows 27 now linked. Filing FIN-1102 to add integration test and prevent metadata stripping. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Nate R: will merge PR #5245 after CI and roll out config toggle for one week.
